narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: a single image that says 'on this world, glow is the baseline' — a Pandoran night forest where the living light, not the sky, is the source of all illumination.
subject: A deep Pandoran rainforest at night seen from a low clearing, every layer of it alive with its own light: a carpet of cyan-green glowing moss across the ground, tall ferns holding steady blue, a fallen trunk crusted with violet bioluminescent fungus, and drifting luminous spores hanging in the air like slow sparks.
scene: The forest understorey opening into a small clearing, towering trunks receding into glowing haze, no sky visible — the canopy closes overhead so all light comes from the organisms themselves.
camera: A low, slightly upward three-quarter view across the clearing floor into the depth of the trees, wide and immersive.
light: Entirely bioluminescent key light — the brightest sources are the moss, ferns, fungus and spores; deep indigo-teal ambient shadow between them, volumetric haze catching the glow in god-ray shafts.
palette: Void-indigo base, Pandora cyan and living teal dominant in the glow, one scarce magenta spore-cluster and a faint amber fungal coal as warm accents.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence.
detail_level: Crisp on the foreground moss, fern fronds and spores; trunks and far forest dissolving into luminous haze.
composition: Layered depth from a glowing foreground floor back into haze, generous dark negative space in the mid-canopy, the eye led inward along the lit ground.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with bioluminescent key from within the scene; the establishing night-forest mood that anchors the whole chapter.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
